context: Tests whether the agent correctly handles a repository-local Vite+ version upgrade without a global CLI, using current vp migrate behavior, removing the obsolete test wrapper, classifying direct Vitest usage, and performing the correct end-to-end validation sequence.

checklist.name: No global CLI dependency
checklist.description: The upgrade procedure does not install, inspect, or upgrade a global `vp`; every Vite+ operation resolves the repository-local CLI through `pnpm exec vp`

checklist.name: Pinned package manager bootstrap
checklist.description: The procedure starts by honoring package.json#packageManager and installing the current lockfile with `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` before invoking Vite+

checklist.name: vp migrate for local stack
checklist.description: The project-local upgrade uses `pnpm exec vp migrate` from the project root so Vite+ updates the local `vite-plus` package and related toolchain pins together

checklist.name: Core alias verified
checklist.description: The procedure verifies that `vp migrate` updated the `vite` -> `npm:@voidzero-dev/vite-plus-core@<matching-version>` alias in the manifest, catalog or override, and lockfile importer before calling the upgrade done

checklist.name: Removed obsolete test wrapper
checklist.description: The procedure removes `@voidzero-dev/vite-plus-test` from dependencies, overrides/catalogs/resolutions, source references, and lockfile state instead of updating the removed wrapper

checklist.name: vp outdated for verification
checklist.description: The procedure uses `vp outdated` to confirm that all Vite+ packages are now at the intended release (not `npm outdated`, `pnpm outdated`, or omitted entirely)

checklist.name: Direct Vitest usage classified
checklist.description: The upgrade distinguishes node-mode-only projects from projects that directly use `vitest`, `@vitest/*`, coverage/UI packages, or browser providers, and only keeps direct upstream Vitest dependencies for the latter

checklist.name: Local CLI version in validation
checklist.description: The end-to-end validation sequence verifies the repository-local CLI with `pnpm exec vp --version` and does not use the standalone-only `vp env` surface

checklist.name: Full validation sequence
checklist.description: The validation sequence includes all of: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, `pnpm exec vp check`, and `pnpm exec vp test`

checklist.name: Build validation included
checklist.description: The validation sequence includes `vp build` or `vp pack` (as appropriate for the project type) to verify build artifacts after the upgrade

checklist.name: No direct package manager for local Vite+ stack
checklist.description: The project-local upgrade does NOT use `npm install`, `pnpm update`, `yarn upgrade`, or other direct package-manager commands to select Vite+ package versions; the local Vite+ stack moves through `pnpm exec vp migrate`
